# Where a render's raise lands, at the edges render_raise_reaches_its_boundary
# leaves out, on every target:
#
# - rows: a loop's row renders a fallible prop. The interpreter ran the
#   boundary's handler in the row's snapshot, so its write was lost.
# - across: a component with no boundary of its own renders under one. The
#   interpreter runs the checked program, which no lowering resolved.
# - slotted: slot content handed to a component built at run time. The copy
#   the content lands in held none of the handler's state: fyne and gtk4
#   did not build, and a page wrote the instance's own state.
# - kinds: what stands where the value was is the type's zero. A map's was
#   null, which a page read through and Kotlin refused, and the interpreter
#   had none for an enum or a payload enum.
# - again: a handler that raises again is heard outside it, and the render
#   still goes on.
#
# Confirmed against the codegen before: each failed on a target it names.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '^ok +5 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '^ok +5 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +5 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +5 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +5 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '^ok +5 tests, 0 failures$'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

enum shade {
    light
    dark
}

enum result {
    ok  int
    bad string
}

func label(n int) string {
    if n == 1 {
        error.raise("one is refused", "bad")
    }
    return "n{n}"
}

func pick(n int) shade {
    if n == 1 {
        error.raise("one is refused", "bad")
    }
    return dark
}

func maybe(n int) option[string] {
    if n == 1 {
        error.raise("one is refused", "bad")
    }
    return "m{n}"
}

func res(n int) result {
    if n == 1 {
        error.raise("one is refused", "bad")
    }
    return result{ok=n}
}

func scores(n int) map[string, int] {
    if n == 1 {
        error.raise("one is refused", "bad")
    }
    return {a=n}
}

func orNone(s option[string]) string {
    if s != null {
        return s
    }
    return "none"
}

func show(r result) => match var v = r {
    ok => "ok{v}"
    bad => v
}

component shows(n int) ui.node {
    ui.text(value=label(n))
}

component box(content ...component ui.node) ui.node {
    var opened = false
    ui.vbox {
        content
        ui.button(text="o", @click {
            opened = !opened
        })
    }
}

// A loop's row renders a fallible prop.
component rows ui.node {
    var ns = [0, 1, 2]
    var err = ""
    boundary(@error(e) {
        err = e.message
    }) {
        for var i = ns {
            ui.text(value=label(i))
        }
    }
}

// A component with no boundary of its own, under one.
component across ui.node {
    var err = ""
    boundary(@error(e) {
        err = e.message
    }) {
        shows(n=1)
    }
}

// Slot content handed to a component built at run time, under a loop.
component slotted ui.node {
    var ns = [0, 2]
    var err = ""
    boundary(@error(e) {
        err = e.message
    }) {
        for var i = ns {
            box {
                ui.text(value=label(i))
            }
        }
    }
    ui.button #step(text="step", @click {
        ns = [0, 1, 2]
    })
}

// What stands where the value was is the type's zero.
component kinds ui.node {
    var n = 0
    var err = ""
    boundary(@error(e) {
        err = e.message
    }) {
        ui.text #a(value="{pick(n)}")
        ui.text #b(value=orNone(maybe(n)))
        ui.text #r(value=show(res(n)))
        ui.text #m(value="{scores(n).length}")
    }
    ui.button #step(text="step", @click {
        n += 1
    })
}

// A handler that raises again is heard by the boundary outside it.
component again ui.node {
    var n = 0
    var outer = ""
    var after = false
    boundary(@error(e) {
        outer = e.message
    }) {
        boundary(@error(e) {
            error.raise("again: {e.message}", "bad")
            after = true
        }) {
            ui.text #t(value=label(n))
        }
    }
    ui.button #step(text="step", @click {
        n += 1
    })
}

func testARowsRaise(t Test, c rows) {
    t.assert(c.err == "one is refused")
}

func testAcrossAComponent(t Test, c across) {
    t.assert(c.err == "one is refused")
}

func testSlotContent(t Test, c slotted) {
    c.step.click()
    t.assert(c.err == "one is refused")
}

func testZeros(t Test, c kinds) {
    c.step.click()
    t.assert(c.err == "one is refused")
    t.assert(c.a.value == "light")
    t.assert(c.b.value == "none")
    t.assert(c.r.value == "ok0")
    t.assert(c.m.value == "0")
}

func testRaisedAgain(t Test, c again) {
    c.step.click()
    t.assert(c.outer == "again: one is refused")
    t.assert(!c.after)
    t.assert(c.t.value == "")
}

ui.window {
    rows
}
